title: Daily Task Manager
summary: Productivity application for organizing daily schedules, prioritizing tasks, and tracking completion.
problem: Unstructured daily task lists lead to low task completion rates and poor time management.
solution: Built a clean task management tool with priority filters, deadlines, and task progress tracking.
features: CRUD task management with priority tags (High, Medium, Low)
Due date notifications and progress completion metrics
Responsive design optimized for quick daily task logging
